title: dev-code-review eval score.json — the reviewer scored against its eval set
description: The output of reviewer_eval.py score: recall over the confirmed bugs in the bad cases and the harmful false-flag rate over the clean cases, from one review.json per case. Zero-LLM and a pure function of (case set, reviews, loop-limits reviewer_eval): no timestamp, no model field, keys sorted, so two scores over the same inputs are byte-identical. Not written through contracts/emit.py (emit stamps timing); the scorer validates against this contract itself before printing. Two scores are comparable only when case_set.sha256 matches.

status.description: The one branch field. incomplete = some case has no valid review, or a denominator is zero (exit 2); fail = below a bar (exit 1); pass = at or above both (exit 0).

recall.description: Caught bugs / all confirmed bugs in bad cases. Bugs of unscored cases count as missed. Null when there are no bugs.

false_flag_rate.description: False-flagged clean cases / clean cases with a valid review. Null when that denominator is 0.

noise_findings.description: Findings of any severity on clean cases. Reported, not gated.

source.description: Where the numbers came from: loop-limits.json reviewer_eval.

sha256.description: sha256 over each case in id order: id NUL case.json bytes NUL change.diff bytes.

unmatched_findings.description: Findings on a bad case that match no confirmed bug. Reported, never penalised.

unlocatable_findings.description: Findings with no integer line; they cannot count as a catch.

reasons.description: Why the status is fail or incomplete: each breached bar, each unscored case id.
